watch.summary: The creator boasts about how clean his Rocket League competitive ranks look, only to point out a single embarrassingly low Plat rank among his Champ ranks.

beats.what: Creator brags about how good his ranks look
Navigates to the competitive playlist screen
Lists off Champ and Champ ranks in 3v3 and 2v2
Bursts out laughing at his own uneven ranks

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The contrast between his high Champ ranks and his lonely Plat rank creates a quick, relatable moment of self-deprecation. His genuine laugh makes the joke land cleanly.
